def compute_mutual_information(p_joint):
    """
    Compute mutual information from joint distribution
    """
    p_x = p_joint.sum(axis=1)
    p_y = p_joint.sum(axis=0)
    mask = p_joint > 0
    mi = np.sum(p_joint[mask] * np.log2(p_joint[mask] / (p_x[:, np.newaxis] * p_y)[mask]))
    return mi
